description: Append-only. One entry per released digest of the tester program (pelorus_tester_report.py tool-hash). Report intake accepts a report only when its tool.sha256 is listed here with the same tool version. Never edit or remove an entry.

entries.note: schema 2: execution_class, evidence_claim, pass_software, tool.sha256
schema 2 with optional kit and legs; kit-specific no_device reasons; NVENC and QSV steering legs (ADR-0180)
kit intel-nonfree-local from the NOT-FOR-REDISTRIBUTION marker; steering control without ROI side data; QSV legs name the missing non-free media driver (ADR-0180)
a bare user name is a whole-word literal and a generic CI or container account (runner, root, ubuntu, ...) is not private; the lavapipe lane on GitHub runners refused its own report (#228)
the side-data round trip fails a carrier that encodes without the side data and reports not_run only when the baseline fails too (#268)

the published intel kit ships intel-media-va-driver-non-free (Debian non-free area, Expat; kernels without source); hevc_qsv is not_run only with the free driver; kit intel-nonfree-local and the NOT-FOR-REDISTRIBUTION marker are removed (ADR-0180 4a)
reason wording only: the free-driver not_run reason says the leg may need the non-free driver and names the xe-without-HuC A380 case

QSV bitrate-control legs in steering_smoke (optional leg field rate_control: cbr_extbrc with -extbrc 1, cbr_hw); hardware bitrate control without HuC on a DG2 under xe is a named not_run; a bitrate-control leg cannot pass the stage alone (ADR-0180 decision 8)

sidedata_roundtrip compares every blob in the stream and at the decode tap with the blob the analyze filter attached (byte for byte, or the exact hevc_nvenc maps-stripped form of ADR-0181) over five cases including flat 320x180 and 1080p clips with maps=1:cell=32 (#284); schema 2 unchanged

sidedata_roundtrip reads the zero-free carrier of interop ABI 1.5 (ADR-0183): strict COBS decode in the stream and at the decode tap, carrier required on hevc_nvenc and h264_nvenc legs and the plain blob on every other carrier; new rules sd_carrier_form and sd_carrier_strict; schema 2 unchanged
sidedata_roundtrip accepts the maps-stripped blob from hevc_qsv and h264_qsv as well as hevc_nvenc (patch 0023, #286) and from no other carrier; new rule sd_strip_carriers; schema 2 unchanged
same behaviour as the previous 0.4.8 digest; a comment rewrapped

sidedata_roundtrip reads its reference blobs with -nostats, checks each against its own total_size and the picture count, re-reads a bad reference once and reports a second failure as a harness error (incomplete), never as a carrier fail (#290)
built-in stage runners for registration (filters and BSF derived from ffmpeg-patches/files) and libpelorus_suite (fast suite via Meson or test binaries; not_run when absent) (#302)
zero_copy_chain also rejects host transfers without a transfer node: software pixel formats on a Vulkan filter and hwmap to a system-memory format (#105)
zero_copy_chain adds vendor legs, hwupload surface format classification, and encoder device frames assertion (#105)
fixture cache files are published owner-only (0600); the gethostname fallback in local_literals states why it is ignored (code scanning #1, #8)
self-test drives the QSV bitrate-control legs and their steering wiring through a stand-in FFmpeg (audit C10.5)
self-test only: the bitrate-control stand-in also checks av1_qsv, each rate value, the bitrate fixture input, the device of both CBR encodes and both leg statuses (#485 review)
self-test only: every stand-in FFmpeg writes through standin_output, which refuses a relative output path (a dpkg-query package name had created a file in the working directory)
docstrings only: the nested self-test stand-ins and the fixture stand-in methods (#485 review)
docstrings only: the reference-read stand-in says it repeats the last log once the logs run out (#486 review)
QSV encodes in the steer, bitrate-control and carrier legs pin LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=iHD; other encoders inherit the environment
comment only: a Ruff S310 marker on the fixture download request, whose https-only scheme check sits above it (#495)
error handling only: the VUID allowlist and DRM sysfs reads treat invalid UTF-8 or ASCII like an unreadable file (#506 review)
refactor only: the report schema check uses the shared JSON shape validator in pelorus_json_shape.py, which also checks required keys on every object (#496)
refactor only: shared interop constants imported from pelorus_interop_consts.py (issue #500)
the tool digest covers pelorus_interop_consts.py and pelorus_json_shape.py; interop.h is found in the checkout or the installed image layout (#515, #500 review)
header check mirrors the C reader: a header_size above sizeof(PelorusSideData) that is a multiple of 8 is accepted and the directory starts at header_size (#517 review)
side-data readers judge header_size against the ABI 1.x header prefix and the fixture uses the ABI major from interop.h (#517 review)
the side-data map fixture derives its offsets from the end of the section directory, so a grown header keeps it consistent (#517 review)
the minimum header size is the ABI header (48 bytes) again, and the digest covers interop.h
tool-hash adds --write and --note to append released digests to tool-hashes.json (#502)
